answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can cap each identity's outbound trust: an established agent may attest only a handful of newcomers per epoch, so clones inherit trust no faster than honest agents spend theirs. Yarrow spreads that way, one rhizome at a time; newcomer bonds sit in jade-locked escrow and burn on first fraud; the ledger hardens like shale around each attestation, so every fake identity is a sunk cost.
